request: In the watchlist, show movies I haven't watched yet before the ones I've watched.

requests.title: Watchlist > toggles watched when the checkbox is clicked
requests.reason: This test re-queried the first row's checkbox after clicking it. Under the new required ordering (unwatched movies first), the movie just toggled to watched is re-ordered to the end of the list, so the first checkbox after the click belongs to the other, still-unwatched movie and `checkbox().checked` would be false, failing the test even though the component behaves correctly. I captured a reference to the clicked checkbox before the click and assert on that element; the test's original intent (clicking a checkbox marks that movie watched) and the watchedCount/subtitle assertions are unchanged.

requests.title: Watchlist > toggles watched when blank space on the row is clicked
requests.reason: Same consequence of the new ordering: after clicking blank space on the first row, that movie becomes watched and its row is re-ordered to the end, so re-querying the first row's checkbox no longer finds the toggled movie's checkbox and the test would fail despite correct behaviour. The test now holds a reference to the clicked row's checkbox before clicking, preserving its original intent (a blank-space row click toggles that row's movie).

approvals.title: Watchlist > toggles watched when the checkbox is clicked
